assets.block: The law behind your File: the three checks
assets.purpose: A simple three step diagram of how an instrument earns its place in a File: checked against its primary text, corroborated by an independent source, and checked for currency on the day. An instrument that fails a check is left out, and the element shows as awaiting verification.
assets.colour: Charcoal #1A1A1A line work and Montserrat labels on white, Care Net red #C5141B for the three check marks, amber #8A5A00 on #FDF3DC for the awaiting verification state
assets.alt: Three checks before any instrument is cited: its primary text, an independent source, and currency on the day
assets.notes: Would sit at the top of the law card, full card width (up to about 950 px), so the PNG fallback is 2400 x 720 for 2x; supply hsf-three-checks-2400x720.png beside the SVG. Label the steps in the page's own plain words. No instrument names, no section or regulation numbers and no gazette numbers on the artwork, because what may be cited changes as the register is reviewed. It must not look like a seal or stamp of approval, and no wording on it may claim that a workplace meets the law. Until it is delivered the card shows text only.
